steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Exactly as the reports say. Such a curious creature.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Growls in warning)

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Easy now, no need to get excited. Seems you understand human speech.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: There are parasites living on these Sea Terrors, but I've never seen them on land before.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: The Iberians call it the 'Nethersea Brand.'

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: An eerie glow has been occasionally seen off the coast of Iberia since the Profound Silence, the earliest known instance dating back to 17 years ago.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Our scientists believe it to be some sort of algal bloom.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: So, have the Ægir also encountered these... unsettling things?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Seldom, but the Academy's garden has no shortage of luminescent ornamental plants.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: So the Ægir do know what the word 'ornamental' means.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Nethersea brand. An apt name. It is the sea leaving its mark on the land.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: At its heart, its spread is no different from the Sea Terrors we saw at Sal Viento.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Do you mean to say this phenomenon is but another form of their evolution?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I see the biologists of Iberia are lacking in many ways.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: We've encountered some complications, but this is far from the worst-case scenario.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: The Inquisition has noted an alarming increase in the variety of Sea Terrors.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Most notably at Coastline 3, where after a mere four or five days our enemies were unrecognizable.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As I said, the ocean encroaches upon the land in its own way.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Now, there's an operator from Rhodes Island I must rescue.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I'll accompany you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No, it'll be more expedient for you to work with the Hunters to eliminate the threat as quickly as possible.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I'd assumed Iberia would treat her with more caution.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Indeed she should be, but for now we have a clearer enemy to deal with.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: What will you do, consul of Ægir? Continue to bicker over your country's pride?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Ten minutes. I'll take care of everything and meet up with my Hunters.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Then, we can talk about how to reach that lighthouse.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: I'll remain here then. Law has been absent from this chapel for far too long, but thankfully someone has been polishing it.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: It will be the only light in this war. The Iberian Inquisition is here, even if it is I alone.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Hey, what's going on?

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: Thiago! Where were you?

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: The Church of the Deep's cultists appeared out of nowhere! And the town's covered in monsters!

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: Oh... and...

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: And what? Why did they attack the town?

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Where's Amaia? Did the monsters harm you?

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: They... they...

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: They didn't harm anyone... they're just fighting... an Inquisitor.

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: No one told the Inquisition! I swear!

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: They showed up not long after we found the carcass in the square. It might've been their work in the first place, now that I think of it.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: What's going on, Uncle? Oh, good afternoon there.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: You look...

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Jordi, come with me.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Uncle?

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Quiet.

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: Th-Thiago, it wasn't us... we couldn't have contacted the Inquisition in such a short time, no matter how fast we were.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: I know. We need to protect Jordi and explain things.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Maybe someone went to them earlier. A week ago, a month ago, who knows? Rumors of cultists have been spreading for a while now.

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: I-It wasn't me! Or my husband!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Could it be Juan? Maybe the Inquisition found him?

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: You knew Juan was a member of the Church of the Deep? When did you find out?

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Jordi! Go!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Uh... alright.

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: Thiago!

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: Oh... he's gone.

steps.name: Alert Townsfolk
steps.text: Never mind him. What about the town?

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: I-I don't know. The Inquisitor and the outsiders are fighting the monsters. There's nothing we can do about it.

steps.name: Alert Townsfolk
steps.text: Tsk... the Inquisitor will be coming for us once he's done.

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: Surely not... wait, what are you thinking?

steps.name: Alert Townsfolk
steps.text: The best-case scenario would be both sides taking each other out...

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: What?! You can't possibly be serious!

steps.name: Alert Townsfolk
steps.text: Think about it. Have we really lost that many people to Sea Terrors? Compared to how much damage the Inquisition has done over the years.

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: B-But...

steps.name: Alert Townsfolk
steps.text: When they come for you, can you prove that you're not a cultist?

steps.name: Indiscreet Townsfolk
steps.text: What are we supposed to do then?

steps.name: Alert Townsfolk
steps.text: If the Inquisitor can really kill that many Sea Terrors, the only way to avoid suspicion would be to hand over someone even more suspicious.

steps.name: Alert Townsfolk
steps.text: For example, an Ægir linked to the Church of the Deep.

steps.name: Sea Terror
steps.text: Gkh...

steps.name: Rear Guard Cultist
steps.text: The others have pulled out. But Amaia is nowhere to be seen.

steps.name: Rear Guard Cultist
steps.text: Both an Inquisitor, and the Abyssal Hunters. I've only heard them mentioned in passing by Amaia.

steps.name: Rear Guard Cultist
steps.text: Here on land, though, they're not as troublesome as the Inquisitor.

steps.name: Rear Guard Cultist
steps.text: Find Amaia. Take her, and delay the Abyssal Hunters.

steps.name: Rear Guard Cultist
steps.text: Go. Our siblings have fallen. We are the last ones standing. The Inquisition must not be allowed to take any more of our comrades.

steps.name: Sea Terror
steps.text: (Shifts head in agreement)

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Jordi, hurry!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: O-Okay...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: (What's happened to the town... are those Sea Terrors too?)

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: It's the Inquisition.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Maybe a High Inquisitor, seeing how he's come to uproot a Church hideout all by himself.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Sea Terrors and cultists have appeared in Gran Faro. There's no explaining this away.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Take this, lad, and the lamp your father left you. Keep them safe.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: You're not a child anymore, Jordi Fontanarossa. I've told you everything. This is your last chance to embrace a new life.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: I... I always wanted to tell you the truth, convince you to leave, but I...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I know, Uncle. You're like a father to me. Gran Faro is our home. If I leave here... I won't have anything left.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: It was going to happen, sooner or later. All the young folks want to leave; you're the exception.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: I'll go with you. Sea Terrors are dangerous, but I know how to deal with them. This is our last chance to slip past the Inquisitors, though.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: What's that sound?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: ...The door?

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Uhh.... Huh?

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: You! Not even Sea Terrors eat people, but you people have no such qualms!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Say something! Pyotr! Manuel! I know it's you out there! Cowards!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: They've blocked the door.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: What? But why?

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Because you're an Ægir.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: They must've surrounded the place. We'll go up to the attic and leave through the roof.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Do I... know you?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Look at you, Laurentina... What happened to your nun's habit? You looked so good in it.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Ah, you found where you belonged, right? The Abyssal Hunters found you, and they want to bring you home?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Laurentina... my name is Laurentina.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: The name of the vast creation's master.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: What is this 'vast creation's master?'

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: The ocean, or its avatar.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Something's not right with your state of mind... You shouldn't be so— Oh, were you awake? When you killed Quintus, for instance?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Quin...tus?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: You touched the sea, but did not immediately proceed to Ægir? I thought you people longed for home.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Or do you have somebody on land, gently guiding you?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Why did we have to reunite under such circumstances, Laurentina?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Your hands, are so cold.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: There was a time when there were no secrets between us.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Now, though...

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Specter!

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: When you remember my name, come and find me. If you still remember this conversation, that is.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: If your mind is your own then, I will tell you the whole truth.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Farewell, Laurentina.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Who was that?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I don't know... but she seems to know me?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: She has no scent. She's not Seaborn, at least not like Quintus.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: We don't have time for her.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Clean up the Sea Terrors, and we'll regroup with the Captain.

steps.name: Blockading Townsfolk
steps.text: Hey, there aren't any Sea Terrors around here, are there?

steps.name: Helping Townsfolk
steps.text: Only dead ones. It's so quiet here... Did the Inquisition take care of them all?

steps.name: Blockading Townsfolk
steps.text: All the better. Come, help me shut them inside. Somebody go fetch the Inquisitor!

steps.name: Helping Townsfolk
steps.text: A-Alright, it's blocked. But why are we doing this to Mayor Thiago when everything's such a mess right now?

steps.name: Blockading Townsfolk
steps.text: Because we're all off to the gallows when things STOP being a mess, unless we do something about it. Go check out the chapel and get someone from the Inquisition.

steps.name: Helping Townsfolk
steps.text: Me? But what if there are still monsters...?

steps.name: Helping Townsfolk
steps.text: Huh? Is there someone on the roof?

steps.name: Blockading Townsfolk
steps.text: Wha—?

steps.name: Blockading Townsfolk
steps.text: It's Jordi and Thiago! Get them! Don't let them get away!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Run!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I, I know!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Get out of town, and don't let the Inquisitors or those bastards catch you!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: *pant* Keep running north... *pant*... There's a messenger station there that might still be in operation...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: I put some money in your bag... *pant*... get out of town, get out of the country!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: A-Alright!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Jordi!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I'm listening!
Thiago's footsteps slow down.
He looks on as the young Ægir runs desperately down the street.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Run! Don't look back! Keep running!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: That's right... get out of here... never look back.

steps.name: Pursuer's Voice
steps.text: Don't let them out of town!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: You were right, lad.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: This is our home, and no amount of waiting or complaining will change that.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: (Ægirian) Farewell, my child!

steps.name: Pursuing Townsfolk
steps.text: Thiago! Where's the Ægir!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Coward!

steps.name: Pursuing Townsfolk
steps.text: W-What the hell are you doing? You'll doom us all! We'll all be branded heretics by the Inquisition, just like the old days!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Are you more afraid of the Inquisition than the Sea Terrors? More afraid of your own people than monsters?

steps.name: Pursuing Townsfolk
steps.text: We already lost everything to the Inquisition once. Do you want that to happen again?

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Pah... your fist is like rubber...

steps.name: Pursuing Townsfolk
steps.text: You—wait, what's that... they're still here?!

steps.name: Sea Terror
steps.text: (Ominous slithering sounds)

steps.name: Pursuing Townsfolk
steps.text: I, I've got to get back to the chapel. The Inquisitors will protect me—

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Take that, you coward!

steps.name: Pursuing Townsfolk
steps.text: Are, are you mad?! Don't you see the Sea Terrors?

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: What about the Sea Terrors?!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Did Sea Terrors eat Gran Faro? No, it was you people... you're worse than the Profound Silence.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: You've slaughtered compassion with selfishness, whitewashed your own cowardice, and blamed the disaster on the Ægir!

steps.name: Pursuing Townsfolk
steps.text: No, the monsters, they're getting closer—screw it, nutjob, I don't have time for this!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Of course, you coward. When they took Marin, when they took the Ægir, you were right there under the banner of the Penal Battalion!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Murderer!

steps.name: Pursuing Townsfolk
steps.text: Don't think the rest of us are gonna humor you just because you fell in love with an Ægir way back when!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Come at me, coward! You'll get it from me!

steps.name: Sea Terror
steps.text: (Sharp sound of breathing)

a.text: The two men become increasingly bloodied as they pummel each other, while Sea Terrors rush by, ignoring them entirely.
They look decidedly out of place.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Thiago...? Uncle Thiago?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Uncle—?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: *pant* Why...?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I... I have to go back...
(Ægirian) Stop right there, Ægir.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Uh, y-yes!

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: The last Ægir of Gran Faro. The last descendant of Breogan.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Breo... what?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: The Sea Terrors would kill you, and the Inquisition would imprison you. Come with me. I need you.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: A-Are you one of them? The ones commanding the monsters?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: No! I seek a lost legend, one that caught the attention of even the Academy.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Yet his most important legacy is neither a lighthouse nor a ship, but his descendant.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: You might be the final clue I'm seeking.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I... don't know what you're talking about.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: That man, Thiago, is not your father. Who were your parents? Your grandparents?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: My parents...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: They... they went missing... in search of the Eye of Iberia.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: As cruel as it is, your misfortune is what gives you the chance to become the salvation of Ægir.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Come with me. I'd prefer not to use force against kin.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I... This is all coming out of nowhere.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Come with me.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: What?! What's going on?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Quiet, bro. I'm saving your life.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: A smoke bomb... I shouldn't have let you get away.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: What's the point of running away with him? You know nothing, Liberi.
You're right, Ægir. There are many mysteries here.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: Transgressor, you will answer my questions, or you will never leave this place.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: I hope you're smart enough to recognize this fact.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Good, looks like we've shaken him off. It was the right choice to grab you when the Inquisitor drew near. They aren't fighting right now, are they?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hello?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Oh, er, sorry... I need to go back to town.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Wouldn't recommend it. Most of the Sea Terrors are gone, but something doesn't feel right. And I can't get in touch with Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Plus... you were planning to leave, weren't you?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I heard that the Inquisitors came to town, and Uncle Thiago was worried I'd be taken away...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: The Inquisition, huh...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: What did that guy want with you, anyway?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Sorry, you don't have to talk if you don't want to.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I'll need a bit of time to decide whether to go back to town and find Dr. Kal'tsit, or get you out of here first.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I'll go with you.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You sure? Your uncle was so desperate to get you out.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: If the Inquisition is coming, I doubt I'll be able to escape.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Is that duty worth giving up your life for?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Huh? What do you—?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: So you're going back to Gran Faro just out of some vague sense of duty, without even a clear goal?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You've gotta be kidding me. If I were you, I'd leave this place, along with any townsfolk who don't want to get involved. And soon.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: This isn't like running into a swarm of Originium Slugs while camping out in the woods. I hate to say it, but ordinary people can't do a thing here.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I just feel like there has to be something left for me to do.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I grew up here, listening to those legends, gazing at the coastline, reading my parents' notes... I don't want my farewell to be like this.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: This place is my home.
